name: Companion Cat
summary: A cat that flies around the Astra window and occasionally says something.
description: A small animated cat drifts across the Astra interface, reacts to clicks, and speaks a line drawn at random from a translated phrase list that follows Astra's own language setting. Purely decorative — it changes nothing about your conversations or settings. It runs its own JavaScript inside the Astra window, which is what an in-window overlay means and why it asks for dom_access.
